author: Claude2 lane, calibration_orchestrator_c2/v002 builder (2026-10-17)
purpose: Classify every terminal outcome of one forward call of driver c2v006 into exactly one class. The orchestrator c2v002 loads THIS file (pinned by sha256 in its config) and evaluates the ordered rules on (driver status, driver reasons, route-A attempt end-record outcome and the stage records of the call directory); never on status alone. The first matching rule wins; anything unmatched is the default class INFRA.

classes.VALID: COMPLETED with 12 finite rows: cached, final.
classes.MODEL_INVALID: The forward at theta ran its declared procedure to a recorded physical refusal. Cached as an invalid evaluation, final, never relaunched.
classes.NUMERICS_LIMITED: A declared-numerics limitation: the physics answer at theta is not established (root outside a declared bracket, search limit, budget, float resolution). NOT cached; the orchestrator HALTS for a root resolve (invalid | retry | retry_with_recovery). Never retried automatically.
classes.INFRA: Everything else (exceptions, ENOSPC, custody/pin/identity mismatch, nonzero exit without a recognized reason, monitor caps, missing receipt, inconsistent records). NOT cached; HALT for a root resolve.

default.rule: any (status, reason, route-A outcome) combination not matched by a rule below, including any status not emitted by c2v006
